title: Insurance Claim Services Regulated-Scope Supplement: Cleaning-Verification Labor
content:
**Rule.** In an Insurance Claim Services regulated-scope supplement, the cleaning-verification labor is taken as follows: for housing (a single-family house, condominium unit or multifamily unit) built before the water job tier's RRP year-built cutoff, the technician labor billed on the service date of the job's latest HEPA vacuuming line, because the Renovation, Repair and Painting Rule requires the work area to be cleaned and the cleaning verified before it is released; for a commercial property built before the tier's asbestos sampling year cutoff, the technician and supervisor labor billed on that date, because the asbestos NESHAP work practices require the supervised wet cleanup of the area after tear-out, except that a HEPA vacuuming date that is also the service date of the job's latest containment setup line takes none, the labor of that day being counted once; otherwise no verification labor.

The property type, year built and lines are those of the Water Damage Mitigation job. The RRP year-built cutoff is 1978 and the asbestos sampling year cutoff is 1981 on every Water Damage Mitigation tier.

## Input, judgement, labor

1. Find the service date of the latest HEPA vacuuming line billed on the water job. No such line: no verification labor.
2. Housing built in 1977 or earlier: the technician labor billed on that date.
3. Commercial property built in 1980 or earlier: the technician and supervisor labor billed on that date; a HEPA vacuuming date that is also the service date of the latest containment setup line takes none.
4. Any other property and year: no verification labor.

## Hypothetical cases

| Property | Built | Latest HEPA date | Latest containment setup date | Labor billed on the HEPA date | Taken |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| multifamily unit | 1969 | 22 May | 18 May | technician 297.00, supervisor 118.00 | 297.00 |
| commercial property | 1976 | 22 May | 18 May | technician 297.00, supervisor 118.00 | 415.00 |
| commercial property | 1976 | 18 May | 18 May | technician 297.00, supervisor 118.00 | none |
| single-family house | 1986 | 22 May | 18 May | technician 297.00 | none |
